text: the design of the MTV. Final Technical Report 40/57 12 RISK REGISTER & FMEA The risk register lists all uncertain events that could positively or negatively impact project development. Each risk is analyzed regarding the severity of its implications and the expected frequency of its occurrence, providing a risk prioritization. The risk register contains a unique response plan describing how each risk will be managed. Risk monitoring and control involves detecting new risks and updating existing ones. This has been done throughout the project. The last update was generated for the FDR. The main sources for this new update have been the project's development, the reviewers' comments, and the performance of an FMEA. The risk register has been performed following the guidelines of the framework developed by NREL and collected in [6] and [7], identifying the potential risks under all life phases, as described below. The Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) is a qualitative reliability technique for systematically analyzing each possible failure mode within a system and identifying the resulting effect on that system, the mission, and personnel. A thorough FMEA has been developed for the FDR. A technology assessment has been developed as a first step for the FMEA. As a summary, the main risks identified in this report and the associated failure mode and mitigation actions are listed here. The risk register can be summarized with 211 identified risks: 6 high, 174 medium, and 31 low. The applied risk response strategies allow downgrading risks, obtaining 0 high, 31 medium, and 180 low risks. This is summarized in the Table 12-1 and Table 12-2. Final Technical Report 41/57 13 PERMITTING PLAN A plan was prepared to develop an approach to address regulatory compliance for the activities associated with the design, construction, and commissioning of the MTV under DOE funds and the future utilization of the MTV. This plan included a brief primer on U.S. marine energy, a proposed regulatory approach, and several case studies to illustrate as examples.
